skills.name: find-skills
skills.description: Discover an installed or external agent skill when the current catalog does not cover the requested capability, and guide safe installation into a DSH-visible skill layer.
skills.when_to_use: Use when a task needs a capability that is missing, unclear, or better handled by a reusable skill.

skills.name: project-memory
skills.description: Read and maintain compact project memory so the agent resumes from current evidence instead of reconstructing state from chat history.

skills.name: skill-router
skills.description: Choose the smallest relevant set of project skills for the current task and avoid loading unrelated instructions.

skills.name: complexity-brake
skills.description: Challenge unnecessary files, abstractions, dependencies, tables, and infrastructure before implementation grows beyond the smallest maintainable solution.

skills.name: memory-consolidation
skills.description: Consolidate project learnings and current truth when working notes or session context become noisy or repetitive.

skills.name: trace-eval-logging
skills.description: Record execution traces, evaluation evidence, and outcomes for important pipeline or engineering changes that need auditable verification.

skills.name: wordpress-plugin
skills.description: Build, extend, review, and refactor WordPress plugins using WordPress lifecycle conventions, hooks, services, repositories, admin UI, REST, cron, and persistence patterns.

skills.name: wordpress-way
skills.description: Prefer native WordPress APIs, conventions, security boundaries, and lifecycle hooks before introducing custom infrastructure.

skills.name: scraping-pipeline
skills.description: Design and operate scraping or ingestion pipelines with controlled acquisition, parsing, validation, dedupe, persistence, retry, fallback, and export behavior.

skills.name: testing-plan
skills.description: Choose focused unit, fixture, integration, regression, and acceptance coverage that proves the current change without building an unnecessary test framework.

skills.name: code-review
skills.description: Review code systematically for correctness, regressions, maintainability, security boundaries, and evidence that the requested behavior is actually covered.

skills.name: api-design
skills.description: Design stable API contracts, request validation, errors, versioning, authentication boundaries, and integration behavior.

skills.name: database-selection
skills.description: Choose storage technology from deployment, data shape, query, durability, and operational evidence instead of habit.

skills.name: database-design
skills.description: Design schemas, keys, migrations, constraints, indexes, and data ownership for systems that genuinely need persistent structured state.

skills.name: interface-design
skills.description: Plan clear UI and component contracts, states, accessibility, interaction flow, and maintainable interface structure.

skills.name: chrome-devtools-mcp
skills.description: Use live browser and Chrome DevTools evidence to inspect, debug, and verify frontend, CSS, JavaScript, rendering, and network behavior.

skills.name: documentation
skills.description: Create and update concise technical documentation, handoffs, README material, and operational guidance that reflects the actual system.

skills.name: architecture-canvas
skills.description: Map system boundaries, responsibilities, data flow, dependencies, and architecture hypotheses before committing to implementation structure.

skills.name: prd-writer
skills.description: Turn a product or feature goal into a structured PRD with scope, behavior, constraints, acceptance criteria, and open decisions.

skills.name: agent-initiative
skills.description: Use bounded initiative to carry obvious low-risk work forward while escalating consequential decisions and respecting project decision rights.

skills.name: oop-standards
skills.description: Apply practical object-oriented design standards, composition, responsibility boundaries, interfaces, and maintainability checks when OOP is justified.
